thread:
Ada K: quick heads-up — I pushed a small automation to flag accounts where onboarding has been idle >7 days and there's no primary contact. want a quick review before we let it create tasks.
Mike L: nice. does this target trials only or all customers? also how do we handle duplicate contacts?
Ada K: trial + self-serve for now. dedupe logic is simple email match then phone fallback. query snippet: ```sql
SELECT id, owner_id FROM accounts WHERE onboarding_days_stalled > 7 AND primary_contact IS NULL AND status IN ('trial','self-serve');
```
Sydney R: can we enrich the rule with recent usage signals? e.g., if product_usage_delta_30d < 0.2, bump priority — avoids flagging people who are actually active but slow on paperwork.
Josh P: +1. also add a cooldown so owners don't get spammed — say 14 days between automated tasks for the same account.
Ada K: implemented cooldown = 14 days. playbook action currently creates: task for owner, tag `onboard-gap`, and posts this short note template to account timeline. template: "Hi — noticed onboarding hasn't progressed in 7+ days. Reply with best contact/time and we'll help finish setup."
cs-bot: automation run: 11 accounts flagged in dry-run. logs: https://internal.redwood/run/2024-11-01/automation-931
Mike L: couple of edge cases: filter out accounts with `status:paused` and exclude enterprise contracts (they have a different workflow). also prefer owner_id != null before creating tasks.
Ada K: good catches — added `status NOT IN ('paused','enterprise-paused')` and `owner_id IS NOT NULL` to the filter. will push update tonight to branch `cs/onboard-gating-v2`.
Sydney R: can I own monitoring for the canary? i'll watch task creation rate, owner acceptance, and any sudden spike in support tickets.
Josh P: i'll handle dedupe post-rollout. flagged two likely false positives from the dry-run where system contact was placeholder `noreply@`. i'll triage those and update the dedupe rules.
Ada K: plan: deploy to canary (10% of self-serve) Fri 03:00 UTC dry-run alerting only, full rollout Mon 02:00 UTC with actual task creation if metrics look green. cc @Mike L for enterprise exclusion review.
Mike L: ack. small suggestion: include `reason_code` in the task metadata (e.g., `stalled-no-contact`, `stalled-low-usage`) so we can filter on what actually moved the needle.
Ada K: adding `reason_code` and small telemetry ping to the event: `{event: 'onboard_auto_flag', reason: reason_code, account_id}`. we'll avoid PII.
cs-bot: scheduled canary deploy 2024-11-01T03:00Z to: cs/onboard-gating-v2 (10%) — status: scheduled :rocket:
Sydney R: i'll standby and post a quick runbook for owners (how to mark as helped, how to snooze).
Josh P: thanks all — good incremental step. we'll evaluate next week and iterate. :thumbsup:
